exposure: Emergency Obstetric Care (EmOC) skills-and-drills training program for healthcare professionals
outcome: number of maternal deaths from direct obstetric causes
cohort: The study focused on 3,237 healthcare professionals in 12 'most-in-need' healthcare districts in South Africa, with outcomes measured from 1,248,333 live births and 2,212 maternal deaths occurring in these districts between January 2011 and December 2016.
finding: Implementing a skills-and-drills Emergency Obstetric Care (EmOC) training package for healthcare professionals was associated with a significant reduction in maternal deaths and direct obstetric maternal deaths.
